name: btw-follow-up-context
title: Support multi-turn BTW follow-up questions
description: Keep the selected quote after submitting a BTW question and include prior question/answer turns in subsequent prompts. A newly selected quote begins a fresh context; Clear resets the conversation. Answers remain isolated from the active terminal.
scope: terminal BTW side-question frontend state and prompt construction
creator: Pi
notes: Implemented lightweight multi-turn context without changing the single-request Pi sidecar lifecycle: successful prior turns are serialized into subsequent prompts; current quote remains after submit; choosing a new quote resets the context; Clear resets it. Added bounded history text and follow-up prompt coverage.
